data.long_meaning: One who is devoted to Allah and obeys His commandments. data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes dedication and submission to Allah.
data.etymology: Obaidiyah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Servant of God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Obaidiyah total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

data.cultural_impact: The name Obaidiyah, derived from the Arabic word 'obaid' which means 'servant' or 'slave', is a name that deeply reflects the cultural and historical significance of Islamic values. Islamic traditions place a strong emphasis on serving and obeying Allah and His Messenger (peace be upon him). This name would have been appreciated and cherished within the Islamic community, as it symbolizes dedication, submission, and obedience to the divine will.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, the name Obaidiyah signifies a deep connection and submission to the divine creator, Allah. By choosing this name for a child, parents are expressing their hope and expectation that their child will grow up to be a devout servant of Allah, following His commandments with faithfulness and integrity.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Servant of God" symbolizes One who is devoted to Allah and obeys His commandments.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Obaidiyah serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of servant of god.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Obaid ibn Hazeem Al-Fihri was the founder of the University of Al-Qarawiyyin in Fez, Morocco, in 859 AD.
historical_references.context: Founder of the oldest existing university in the world

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Obaid ibn Qatadah was a prominent scholar of the Quran and Hadith in the 10th century. The name Obaidiyah carried significant weight in that era.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Obaidiyah remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.

name_in_real_life.story: A successful entrepreneur named Zainab Obaidiyah in Cairo, Egypt attributes much of their success to the blessing of their name Obaidiyah, which means "Servant of God". They believe their name has shaped their identity and guided them through life.
